chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Razma al-Qazwini narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Isa al-Alawi al-Husayni narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa'id Abbad ibn Ya'qub narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Hashim ibn al-Burayd narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi', from Awn ibn Ubaydullah. He said:

I was with Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Hanafiyya at the entrance of his house. Then Zayd ibn al-Hasan passed by him, and he raised his gaze toward him, then said: A man from the descendants of al-Husayn called Zayd ibn Ali will surely be killed and crucified in Iraq. Whoever looks at his exposed state and does not come to his aid — Allah will throw him face-first into the Fire.

key_terms.أَكَبَّهُ: To throw face-forward, prostrate; implies utter disgrace
key_terms.عَوْرَة: Literally 'a thing to be concealed'; here referring to the humiliation of the martyr's exposed body on the cross
key_terms.فِنَاء: The courtyard or forecourt of a house; the open area at its entrance

ai.seo_question: What did Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyya prophesy about Zayd ibn Ali?
ai.summary: Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyya, the son of Imam Ali (AS) from a wife of Banu Hanifa, uttered a prophecy upon seeing Zayd ibn al-Hasan (grandson of Imam Hasan) pass by. He declared that a man from Imam Husayn's descendants named Zayd ibn Ali would be killed and crucified in Iraq — a prediction that came true when Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (d. 122 AH) rose against the Umayyads and was martyred and crucified in Kufa. The hadith also contains a solemn warning: anyone who witnesses Zayd's state of martyrdom and does not support him will be cast face-first into the Fire by Allah.
word_analysis: and he will surely be crucified
Allah will throw him face-first/prostrate him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Razma al-Qazwini narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Isa al-`Alawi and Husayni narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id `Abbad b. Ya`qub narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Hisham b. al-Burayd narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Ubaydullah b. Abi Rafi` from `Awn b. `Ubaydullah. He said:

I was with Muhammad b. `Ali, the son of al-Hanifiyya, at the exit of his house. So, Zayd b. al-Hasan passed by me and raised his glance to me and said: A man from the descendants of al-Husayn called Zayd b. `Ali will be killed and crucified in Iraq. Whoever looks at his private (or form) and does not come to his aid, Allah will throw him face-first into the Fire.
